levels.surface: عبد الله بن مسلمة بن قعنب

notes: «- يعني ابن بلال -» is an editor's gloss: left out (rule 1)
«أنه سمع عمر بن عبد العزيز، يسأل السائب بن يزيد» puts Umar in the scene: a man who asks inside another's story is not a link (rule 5)
the asked Sa'ib answers and relays from al-Ala, so he is a link (rule 6); the Prophet ends the chain
